LONG LET. A beautifully presented 2 bedroom flat, benefiting from a spacious reception room and semi-open-plan kitchen, ideally located with Hampstead in easy reach.
Situated within easy reach of the exclusive shops, bars and restaurants of Hampstead Village. The nearest underground station is Hampstead (Northern Line).
Please use the reference CHPK0007812 when contacting Foxtons.

Deposit Free Option!!!
TWO BEDROOM GROUND FLOOR APARTMENT WITH PRIVATE GARDEN
Oyster Properties is proud to present this well maintained 2 bedroom apartment with its own entrance, located a short walk from Arnos Grove & New Southgate Tube Station. The Property consists of a spacious lounge, modern kitchen with fitted appliances, two good size bedrooms and a family bathroom. Other benefits include wooden flooring throughout and a private rear garden.
Local Authority: Enfield Council (
Council Tax Band: C
Annual Council Tax Cost: £1,924
Weekly Deposit: £438
5 Weeks Deposit: £2,190
Available Now!!
EPC Rating: E

John D Wood & Co in Primrose HIll would like to present a truly unique studio apartment situated on the first floor of a period conversion in the heart of Primrose Hill; the perfect short let. Having been brand newly refurbished the studio room has a newly fitted kitchen with modern appliances, mezzanine sleeping platform, fitted storage and separate shower room. Located in the centre of Primrose Hill village and a short walk from the High Street and Park. Energy rating D. Council Tax Band A.

Two bedroom first floor flat in Enfield Island Village will leave it's impression. The property boasts secure entry, good sized hall leading on to the great sized master bedroom with EnSuite . The Lounge diner is of generous proportions and leads on to a good sized kitchen and family bathroom. The first to see will take this so get dialing!
This property is available with a Deposit Free option which means that instead of paying a traditional five weeks security deposit, you pay a fee of one weeks rent + VAT (subject to a minimum of £120 + VAT) to become a member of a deposit free renting scheme which significantly reduces the up-front costs. This fee is non-refundable and is not a deposit so cannot be used towards covering the cost of any future damage.

Superb en-suite with own Bathroom, Gym access, just kitchen shared only with one another person, contemporary and stylish with superb features and excellent location, making it ideal for students, postgraduates or professionals. The properties bedrooms are furnished with desks and wardrobes, the kitchen is brand new and fully fitted with integrated appliances including microwave, oven, washing Machine, full fridge & freezer is shared with one other person. With double glazing, wooden floors and electric heating throughout, the property also has lift access and a secure door code entry to ensure tenant security. The utilities include electricity, wifi and water supply. A direct internet connection is also provided.
The en-suites are in very well located in between Hampstead, Golders Green, Belsize Park, West Hampstead, Swiss Cottage, St Johns Wood, Regents Park and the famous Camden Market. The area has excellent local amenities including supermarkets, restaurants, bars, banks, O2 Centre, Virgin Active sports club, Vue cinema, Sainsbury supermarket, Starbucks, Waterstones book store and many other useful shops all in short walking distance of the property.
The location off of the Finchley Road in a quiet residential road provides excellent transport links with both Finchley Road Underground and Finchley & Frognal Overground within a few minutes walk and regular bus/train service connections to all London districts and Heathrow are close by.
